about: Story scenes of Volume 1, chapter 4, Vermilion Ruins: the stolen Phoenix fire, the Silver Fox, and Yan Feihong joining (draft).

lines.text: The thread that pulls south burns. Past the river country, the green fades and the roads turn black with old lava. The mountains ahead glow red at night.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Hot. Sticky. No hawthorn sellers for fifty li. I want a raise.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: You've been employed for nine days.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Nine very hot days.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Drink water, everyone. Slowly. Tao Yao, you too.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: I'm fine! Peach blossoms love sunshine. Just not... this much sunshine.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: The Vermilion Phoenix Palace is up ahead. They've guarded a sealed fire there since before the Withering. If the Netherflame Sect wants anything in the south, it's that.
On the black road ahead, something moves: dogs made of drifting ash, eyes like coals, breath shimmering with heat.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Ash hounds. Water quenches fire. This will be quick.
The Vermilion Phoenix Palace rises from the crater of a sleeping volcano, all red pillars and golden roofs. In its highest hall stands a great bronze altar, open and empty, its seals cut.
The Palace is in uproar. In the middle of the uproar, fire blazing at her sleeves, stands a girl in vermilion.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: YOU! Our sacred fire vanishes, and three days later, strangers just stroll in through the front gate?

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Thieves rarely use the front gate.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Clever thieves do! Hand it over, or I'll burn you down to the soles of your boots!

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Is she always like this?

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Please, we haven't taken anything. We came because we feared someone would try.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: A likely story! I am Yan Feihong, first disciple of the Phoenix Palace, and I have never lost a fight. Not one!

lines.speaker: npc:elder_zhu_yan
lines.text: Feihong. Sit down before you set the curtains alight again.
An old woman with copper-red hair and a long pipe walks in slowly. The disciples part around her like water around a stone.

lines.speaker: npc:elder_zhu_yan
lines.text: The seals were cut three nights ago, with illusions and a very sharp claw. These strangers were three days' walk away. I watched their dust on the road myself.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: ...Then they're accomplices!

lines.speaker: npc:elder_zhu_yan
lines.text: That fire has burned on our altar since before the Withering. Netherflame is fire that has forgotten what it was. Ours remembers. In the wrong hands, it could be taught to forget.

lines.speaker: npc:elder_zhu_yan
lines.text: So go with them, Feihong, and watch them. If they are thieves, you will catch them. If they are not, you will catch the thief.

lines.speaker: npc:elder_zhu_yan
lines.text: Pavilion Master, that lotus at your belt is very old. Older than this Palace. I won't ask where you found it. Bring back our fire, and the Palace will owe you.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Elder! I don't need a babysitting job, I need a thief to burn!

lines.speaker: npc:elder_zhu_yan
lines.text: And they need a guide who knows fire. Go. And try to stay calm.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Don't say "calm"!

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: ...Fine! But I'm walking in front. And if you turn out to be thieves, I burn you first.
On the terraces below the Palace, grey flames flicker among the red rocks: Netherflame casters, searching the ash for something.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Look at that. More thieves, late to the party. They came for the fire too.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: So, not us.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: I haven't decided about you yet!

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Here's my trial. We fight them together. If you can keep up with me, I'll believe you're not useless. If you can't, I'll leave you in the ash.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Keep up with you?

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Try it and see! Phoenix fire, rise!
Between two lava fields lies a steaming marsh of black water and hot springs. An old man with silver scales on his cheeks sits on a stone at its edge, fishing without bait.

lines.speaker: npc:chief_bai_lin
lines.text: You walk loudly, children. Every fish in my marsh has heard you coming. Sit.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: We don't have time to sit! A thief came this way. Did you see her or not?

lines.speaker: npc:chief_bai_lin
lines.text: I see everything that crosses my water, little phoenix. I am old, and the old are patient. You are young, so you will be patient too, or you will learn nothing.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Forgive her, Chief. How can we earn your answer?

lines.speaker: npc:chief_bai_lin
lines.text: Some of my guards have gone bad. Netherflame coin in their bellies, venom in their tempers. They've made a nest in the eastern springs and bite anyone who passes.

lines.speaker: npc:chief_bai_lin
lines.text: Clear the nest, and I'll tell you where your thief went. Most who come to my marsh leave owing me a favour. You may be the first to leave even.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: A snake who keeps his word. Rare.

lines.speaker: npc:chief_bai_lin
lines.text: Rarer than a Moonshadow girl who works for sweets. Off you go.
The rogue guards slither off into the steam, hissing. Chief Bai Lin hasn't moved from his stone. His line still has no bait.

lines.speaker: npc:chief_bai_lin
lines.text: Neatly done. Now. On the night your fire was stolen, someone crossed my marsh heading east, toward the old palace. Light on her feet. Smelled of perfume and smoke.

lines.speaker: npc:chief_bai_lin
lines.text: She carried a lantern that made my springs boil as she passed. And she was crying.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Crying?

lines.speaker: npc:chief_bai_lin
lines.text: Thieves are people too, little phoenix. Even the ones you'd like to burn.

lines.speaker: npc:chief_bai_lin
lines.text: Take some tea leaves from my springs for the road. They're very calming.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: I hate tea. And don't say "calming"!

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: I'll take them. Thank you, Chief.
East of the marsh, the ash fields shimmer. Paths appear and vanish. A ruined gate stands where there was none a moment ago, then melts like smoke.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Illusions. Clumsy ones.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Not clumsy. Hurried.
Caught on a jagged rock is a tuft of fur, fine as silk, shining silver in the red light.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Silver fur... Pavilion Master, it's Lady Hu Qiao's runaway kit.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Silver fur, sharp tongue, sticky fingers. Sticky enough to lift a sacred fire, apparently.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: A fox? A FOX stole the Phoenix Palace's fire? I'll singe every tail she has!

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: We promised Lady Hu Qiao we'd send her home alive.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: YOU promised! I never promised any fox anything!
The ash stirs. Figures in fox masks rise out of the illusion, blades in hand.
In the shade of a fallen pillar, drenched in sweat, Old Qian sits on his cart fanning himself with a ledger.

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: Customers! In a volcano! Heaven still loves Old Qian, though it has a funny way of showing it.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: You were at Peach Blossom Ford!

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: And now I'm here. Fire-proof boots, flame-proof gloves, cooling talismans, freshly expired. The Guild sends me wherever things are on fire, remember?

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Have you seen a fox? Silver fur. Thief.

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: A silver fox? Ah. Hm. Well. Funny you should mention silver foxes.

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: Last year, purely in the course of honest business, the Guild may have bought a feather from a silver fox. Red and gold. Warm to the touch. It never stopped glowing.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: That's a PHOENIX feather! From OUR Palace! You bought stolen goods from our thief?

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: Allegedly bought! The auction house never asks questions. Questions are terrible for business! Madam Jin will have my cap for telling you this.

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: Here, here. A peace offering for the young lady. A silk fan, with a painted phoenix. Very fine. Almost as fierce as you.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: ...It is a nice fan.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: That doesn't mean I forgive you!
Beneath the ruins of the first Phoenix Palace, abandoned a thousand years ago, rivers of magma run through halls of black glass.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: The old palace. Only Phoenix disciples know the way through. Lucky for you, I'm the best of them.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Do you ever say anything humbly?

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: I'm humble every single day! Just never out loud.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Mind your sleeves near the magma, Ling Shuang.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: My sleeves are fine. The hounds will not be.
Ash hounds and grey fire wait in the glowing halls ahead.
The magma halls open onto the old palace's great gate, a broken arch of red stone. Beyond it, a lantern glows gold and red in the dark: the sealed fire.
From the far side of the arch, black-robed figures march in. At their head, a cultist carries a lacquered box sealed with a withered branch.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: The Envoy's payment. He's buying the fire.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Then we arrived first.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Nobody buys Phoenix fire! Not with jade, not with anything!

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Pavilion Master, if that lantern leaves this place...

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: It won't.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Ha! Finally, somebody around here talks sense!
In the shadows behind the gate, a young woman with silver hair and silver tails clutches the burning lantern to her chest. Her eyes are red.

lines.speaker: npc:hu_yinling
lines.text: Well, well. The Pavilion Master and their flowers. Lady Hu Qiao sent you, didn't she? She always did love a rescue she doesn't have to do herself.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Give back our fire, thief!

lines.speaker: npc:hu_yinling
lines.text: I can't. You don't understand. If the Envoy doesn't have this lantern by the next full moon, his contract eats my soul. Every last tail of it.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Ku Ye...

lines.speaker: npc:hu_yinling
lines.text: He pulled me out of a hunter's net the week after I ran away from home. One favour, he said. One small theft. And now it's the fire, or me.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: There's another way.

lines.speaker: npc:hu_yinling
lines.text: There's never another way with him. I'm sorry, little phoenix. I'm faster than you, and I'm much, much better at lying.
The ash around her blooms into a hundred silver foxes, every one of them smiling.
The silver foxes burst like soap bubbles. Hu Yinling sinks to her knees in the ash, and the lantern rolls from her hands.
Yan Feihong catches it before it touches the ground. Inside, the sealed fire flares gold at her touch, like a bird that knows its keeper.

lines.speaker: npc:hu_yinling
lines.text: Take it. Take it back. I'm so tired of running.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: You stole from the Phoenix Palace! You sold one of our feathers! You...

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: ...You're actually crying.

lines.speaker: npc:hu_yinling
lines.text: When his contract comes due, I'll do worse than cry.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: Then he'll have to come through us to collect.

lines.speaker: npc:hu_yinling
lines.text: You'd do that? For a thief?

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: We promised your clan we'd send you home alive. We keep our promises.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: And the Envoy is already my mark. I'll collect for both of us.

lines.speaker: npc:hu_yinling
lines.text: ...The old vixen always said I'd meet someone too soft to rob. I never believed her.
Hu Yinling slips away through the ash toward the bamboo country, and home. This time, she looks back.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Hmph. You didn't burn her.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: And you fought well. Better than well. Not as well as me, obviously. But you kept up.
The lantern pulses in her hands, and the Fate Lotus at your belt answers it. A red-gold thread leaps between you and Yan Feihong, hot as a festival bonfire.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: What... what is this? My chest feels like a firework about to go off!

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: That's your Dao Seed saying hello. It seems to like the Pavilion Master.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Fine! FINE. Once the fire is back on its altar, I'm coming with you. Somebody has to burn the Netherflame Sect properly, and clearly none of you can manage without me.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Yan Feihong of the Phoenix Palace! Whoever stole our fire, I beat them. And whoever paid for it, I'll burn!

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: She's going to be loud, isn't she?

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Very.
